_comment: Per-subject curation for the ETG (Elite Temple Guard) unit-analysis video. The METHOD lives in code; this file holds only the ETG-specific choices, applied by build_v2_categorization.py.
_remove_note: The generic Battle Elephant staple is modal-Bengalis; the video uses the BURMESE Elite Battle Elephant instead (see extra_results) — user choice 2026-07-19, the Howdah-armored variant (320 HP, 6/9 armor, vs Vietnamese's 420 HP); same 100F/70G cost, re-simmed fresh with the current frozen model.
_extra_results_note: These two were simmed separately (15 seeds, MAX_S=180) via a single-matchup V2 run rather than the batch. To re-sim them in the batch instead, move their keys into `add` and drop them here.
_ingame_note: Only matchups with an UNMODELED combat mechanic stay pinned; everything else the sim must earn (and now does: the Arambai pin retired 2026-07-19 when GRAZE_K made it a native loss at S -26, the War Elephant pin when TRAMPLE_K made it native S -33). White Feather Guard: V2 says +12/80% ETG win, but 5 in-game rolls (wfg_rolls/) were a 0/5 ETG LOSS (WFG keeps 8-14u / 25-38% HP, ~33s) — WFG has an unmodeled sustain mechanic (the extracted +0.5%/nearby Coiled Serpent HP aura, cap +15%, is far too small to explain it); NOT a CHURN artifact (wrong at 3.5=60% too). Warrior Priest (added 2026-07-19): V2 says 73% ETG with both armies shredded (9%/4% HP), but 2/2 in-game runs were decisive WP wins keeping ~15/21 units. Mechanism UNIDENTIFIED — per the user, WP healing is an out-of-combat effect (heals after the fight, not during) and should NOT decide battles, so this is NOT a heal-aura gap; the WP simply over-performs the sim's read of its raw stats in the melee grind. Ground truth = loss; revisit if a mid-fight mechanic is identified. (WFG note: its +0.5%/nearby HP aura IS modeled in simulate.js — the gap persists despite it.)
_exclude_note: Genitour is never shown in the video (not a useful/representative unit); it still appears in the full table.
